## When do the brackets repeat?

Factorise both expressions on paper. Which has identical brackets?

**A.** $x^2+10x+25$&emsp; **B.** $x^2+26x+25$

::: {.fragment}

Both have $P=25$ and a positive sum, so list positive pairs.

:::

::: {.fragment}

| Signed pair | Sum |
|:--|:--|
| $1,\ 25$ | $26$ |
| $5,\ 5$ | $10$ |

:::

::: {.fragment}

**A.** $S=10$: choose $5,5$. Hence $x^2+10x+25=(x+5)^2$.

:::

::: {.fragment}

**B.** $S=26$: choose $1,25$. Hence $x^2+26x+25=(x+1)(x+25)$.

:::
